notes: Both supplied As for expressions were aligned to the fronted nominals under rule 33. Rule 16's third-family limit governs them and forbids that reading: neither הַהֵיכָל nor וּפְנֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ carries an object marker or a fronting לְ, so no morpheme licenses the expression and each is its own added unit headed on as. The rest of the verse is returned as the verse pass had it.
